rows.response_text: To sell stuff on eBay, you need to first set up a seller account and then create and manage your listing. You can use the quick listing tool to quickly list your item by providing guidance on pricing and shipping. If you want to set a minimum or reserve price on your item, you can learn how to do so. Additionally, you can find out how to sell multiple items and offer Get It Fast options to attract quick sales. To optimize your listings, consider including relevant keywords in your title and researching similar auctions to set an appropriate price. It is important to note that once someone buys your item or the auction ends, it constitutes a binding agreement to sell, and canceling the sale would require mutual agreement.
